parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry points for distinct app targets: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. The structural similarity (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots) is purely a consequence of the SwiftUI App protocol boilerplate pattern, not a sign of duplicated logic. Each alias is bound to its own target and package (WXUI, Wallpaper, PlayerHeaderView, app:WatchXYC, app:WXYC TV), so extracting or merging them would be meaningless — there is no shared body to consolidate. The coincidence is structural only; the domain concepts (sample apps, watch app, TV app) are intentionally separate.
